description.value:
You tear a rift in linear time and shape it into a translucent, rippling wall of temporal energy at a point within range. The wall is intangible; creatures can move through it freely, but crossing it costs significant action economy.

A creature that crosses the wall (in either direction) must expend an additional action to do so; if the creature crosses as part of a Stride, that Stride counts as having moved an additional 10 feet of difficult terrain. Nonmagical ranged attacks that cross the wall automatically miss, and magical ranged attacks that cross the wall must succeed at a flat check (DC 11) or miss. Each round you Sustain this spell, you may move the wall up to 20 feet along the ground.

Heightened (7th) The wall also imposes a Fortitude save (DC = your spell DC) on any creature that passes through it; on a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 1} until the start of its next turn.
